text:
alex: After upgrading our us-west-2 clusters to k8s 1.26 this morning, GPU nodepools stopped scaling up for batch jobs. CA logs show "no matching node group for template". Anyone seen this?

maria: Can you paste CA logs? Which CA image are we on?

alex: CA logs excerpt:
```
I0205 09:12:34.123456 1 node_group.go:218] Failed to get node group for template: key not found: "cloud.alpha.kubernetes.io/node-group"
E0205 09:12:34.123789 1 autoscaler.go:491] ScaleUp failed: no nodegroups found for template
```

We're on cluster-autoscaler: k8s.gcr.io/autoscaler/cluster-autoscaler:v1.26.0

jin: This looks like the cloud provider changed node pool label keys in the node object after the k8s upgrade. We saw similar where the managed node pool adds `topology.kubernetes.io/node-pool` instead of the old `cloud.alpha.kubernetes.io/node-group`. CA only looks for legacy key. Quick fix: add legacy label to nodes or patch CA to accept new key.

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-3472 - autoscaler nodegroup discovery failures in us-west-2 (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INC-3472)

rahul: We hit the same in eu-west-1 earlier this week. I opened a PR upstream that maps both keys: https://github.com/kubernetes/autoscaler/pull/4823 — we tested on staging and it worked. Suggest cherry-picking that patch into our CA image.

maria: Short-term mitigation?

alex: Temporary mitigations we've applied:
- Add legacy label to node templates in the cloud provider console for new nodes.
- Deploy this DaemonSet to patch nodes on boot:

```
kubectl apply -f - <<EOF
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: DaemonSet
metadata:
  name: node-labeler
  namespace: kube-system
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      hostPID: true
      containers:
      - name: labeler
        image: busybox
        command: ["sh","-c","kubectl label node $(hostname) cloud.alpha.kubernetes.io/node-group=gpux --overwrite"]
EOF
```

This is ugly but buys time.

jin: FYI PR #4823 is small; Rahul can you cut a branch image tag we can run as canary? Also proposal to pin CA to our patched 1.26 build and run in canary us-west-2 small cluster before rolling.

lena: Cost note — because CA didn't scale up, jobs fell back to on-demand and we used more preemptible GPUs via the batch broker, which spiked costs. Preliminary estimate: ~$12k extra in the last 6 hours across regions. Need to include in post-incident cost report.

rahul: I'll open a vendor ticket as well and cut a patched image now. I'll link PR and image: https://ghcr.io/redwood/autoscaler:v1.26-fix-nodekey

maria: I'll own the canary rollout. Plan: stage -> canary us-west-2 small cluster at 10:30 UTC, validate scale up with synthetic load, then promote. Also schedule a maintenance window for other clusters.

sre-bot: Incident INC-3472 status: Mitigating -> Monitoring

alex: After canary we should add an integration test in our infra repo that upgrades a cluster minor version and runs scale tests. Can't rely on manual checks.

maria: Agreed. I'll file INFRA-982 for the upgrade smoke test (https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INFRA-982)

alex: Thanks everyone. :thumbsup: Keep updates in this thread.

jin: Heads-up: make sure node template CRD in our infra pipeline includes both labels going forward. :eyes:
